text:
maya: quick sync — PR #34901 needs runtime + infra + security sign-off before we push the fallback-routing change to canary. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/34901

maya: brief checklist (tl;dr):
```
- runtime: perf smoke (99th latency < 120ms for our small batch sim)
- infra: eviction/header change review + infra tests pass
- security: KMS & audit log review for the new route metadata
- ops: schedule 30m canary window (low-traffic slot)
```

maya: @devon @oliver @sophie tagging you all because this touches runtime/infra/sec. Who can take which item today? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

devon: I can own the runtime smoke run. Plan to run a short harness in staging — will post numbers in ~45m.

oliver: I can review the infra bits. Quick note: we changed the eviction header name in a follow-up commit, so I want to validate rolling update behavior. Can you include the rollout command you plan to use?

maya: rollout command (for reference):
```bash
./orchctl rollout start --service runtime --canary 10% --duration 30m --fallback-model small-quant
```

devon: thanks — I'll run perf with that config and include the KV-cache warmup step. If 99th is >120ms I'll try reducing batch size.

sophie: I'll take sec review. Quick asks up front:
- Is any new customer PII in the route metadata?
- Are we adding new KMS scopes or key usage?
If both are no, I can usually complete an initial review same day.

maya: no PII, just internal route tags. KMS: new key usage for signing route events (separate key), will add to the KMS policy doc in the PR description.

sam: fyi ops — there is a free 16:00-16:30 PT canary slot today per the calendar. If everyone signs off, we can aim for that. :calendar:

oliver: good, I'll check the rolling update behavior against a small canary in my staging cluster. If infra tests pass, I can +1. Expect results in ~1h.

devon: perf run done: 99th = 108ms (10k samples, small-batch, KV warm). CPU/GPU utilization looks normal. Posting abbreviated logs:
```
99th_latency_ms: 108
avg_token_throughput: 182 tokens/s
KV_cache_hit: 92%
```

maya: awesome, thanks @devon.

sophie: quick sec update — KMS key usage looks limited to signing only, audit logs config added to PR. I have one minor comment about masking route IDs in logs, leaving it as a small TODO but not blocking. I can approve after that change.

oliver: infra tests passed (eviction/rolling tests). Left 2 tiny comments on the manifest ordering — non-blocking. I can +1.

maya: summary: runtime/perf: good; infra: +1 with minor nits; sec: will give +1 once masking TODO is addressed. Can we aim to merge at the 16:00 PT slot? @sophie can you confirm the minor change is something you can push quickly?

sophie: yes I can push a short log-masking patch in ~10m and then give final +1.

deploy-bot: Notice — canary slot reserved: 2025-02-03T16:00:00-08:00 for runtime service. Remember to follow rollback playbook if errors >5% or latency regressions.

maya: perfect. I'll hold the merge until sec +1 and then do the rollout command at 16:00 PT. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :rocket:

sam: adding a tiny ops note — please add a short post-canary check in #eng-sre with observed 1h metrics so we can validate end-to-end.

maya: will do.

devon: leaving a follow-up comment on the PR with the perf harness and raw logs.

maya: thanks all — closing the loop here.
